missing.what_was_said: Management said: “For OpenAI, we have delivered silicon, and we are on track for production late 2026.” This distinguished silicon delivery from the subsequent production and deployment milestones.
Management reported shipping Jalapeño, OpenAI’s first-generation custom accelerator, in Q3 and said shipments would continue.

Management said the next-generation XPU beyond Jalapeño was approaching tape-out and that it had “line of sight” for OpenAI to deploy over 5 GW of Jalapeño and its successor in 2028. This was a forward-looking deployment milestone, not an achieved deployment.
